title: T-Mobile Just Launched a New Better Value Plan Focused on Everyday Savings for a Limited Time
summary: The plan is perfect for families looking for more breathing room when it comes to wireless pricing.
contentText:

For small but mighty families, everything seems to be getting increasingly expensive.
Between rising grocery bills, streaming subscriptions and the cost of keeping multiple devices connected, many families are taking a closer look at their monthly expenses. T-Mobile’s new limited-time Better Value family plan  is designed to help ease that pressure by focusing on predictable wireless pricing, rather than short-term device promotions.

The Better Value plan will run users $140 a month for three lines with AutoPay — just $46 per line, plus taxes and fees. The best part? No random price increases, given T-Mobile offers a five-
year price guarantee on talk, text and data, giving users a better understanding of what they’ll be paying for each month. The reason why ShopBillboard vouches for this plan is that savings are based on plan price and included benefits, not flimsy temporary discounts.

Take Advantage Of t-Mobile's Better Value Plan

The plan  is available to new users and small businesses who feel pressure from rising wireless bills. In short, this one’s for families and households looking to save some extra cash when everything seems to be getting more expensive. To qualify, you must have at least three-plus voice lines and at least two of those lines must switch to T-Mobile from another carrier.

Another amazing perk of this plan is that it doesn’t take hours on the phone to switch. No clunky shifts, no awkward holds on the phone. The switch is fast and easy, taking only 15 minutes per line , all done through the T-Life app.
